This template is used for the backups in the ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|Knights of the Old Republic]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]]. Enter the issue in which the backup appeared (issue [[Knights of the Old Republic 0|#0]] or issues [[Knights of the Old Republic 13|#13]]-[[Knights of the Old Republic 24|24]]), and it will format properly.

==Example of usage==
<code><nowiki>{{KOTORbackups|19}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{KOTORbackups|19}}
